question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH calendar AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(day, SEQ4(), '2025-01-01'::DATE) AS calendar_date
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 365))
), daily AS (
  SELECT c.calendar_date,
         DAYOFWEEKISO(c.calendar_date) AS weekday_num,
         SUM(IFF(o.IS_DELIVERED, 1, 0)) AS delivered_orders
  FROM calendar c
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = c.calendar_date
  GROUP BY c.calendar_date
)
SELECT CASE weekday_num
         WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
         WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday'
         WHEN 7 THEN 'Sunday'
       END AS weekday,
       COUNT(*) AS calendar_dates,
       AVG(delivered_orders) AS average_delivered_orders_per_date
FROM daily
GROUP BY weekday_num
ORDER BY weekday_num
action.metrics: Average count of delivered orders per calendar date in 2025, grouped by weekday; all dates included, including zero-order dates.

action.answer: Average Delivered orders per calendar date in 2025 (including dates with zero Delivered orders): Monday 9094.365385 (52 dates); Tuesday 9082.788462 (52); Wednesday 9053.773585 (53); Thursday 9473.653846 (52); Friday 12228.980769 (52); Saturday 14486.211538 (52); Sunday 13119.134615 (52). Saturday had the highest average, at 14486.211538 Delivered orders per calendar date.
